description: Philip Morris International Inc. is a Virginia holding company incorporated in 1987 that became a U.S. public company listed on the New York Stock Exchange in March 2008, and it is a leading international consumer goods company actively delivering a smoke-free future and evolving its portfolio for the long term to include products outside of the tobacco and nicotine sector. Its current product portfolio primarily consists of cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, nicotine pouch and e-vapor products, and since 2008 it has invested over $16 billion to develop, scientifically substantiate and commercialize innovative smoke-free products for adults who would otherwise continue to smoke, with the goal of completely ending the sale of cigarettes, including building world-class scientific assessment capabilities in pre-clinical systems toxicology, clinical and behavioral research and post-market studies. In November 2022 it acquired Swedish Match AB, a leader in oral nicotine delivery, creating a global smoke-free combination.
